quarterly_data.signal: Company milestone, May 2026: 400G/800G VCSEL optical-communications products continue to ramp in volume; photodiode technology is in development and validation. Earlier milestones: VCSELs for AR/VR products passed customer validation and entered mass production (February 2022); monthly capacity expanded to 15,000 wafers (September 2021); the company became a subsidiary of Sino-American Silicon Products (June 2022).
